source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 段狂反扑，拓拔野喝止
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC17 after EP02 SC16 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from Duan Yukai being driven back into the next turn of escalation: he erupts with the self-damaging wood magic万壑春藤绕 and briefly turns the tide; the black-clothed Chaoyang Valley fighters swarm in; the old musician joins the suppression; Duan Yukai finally falls under combined pressure; outraged, hidden Tuobaye shouts for everyone to stop and is mistakenly taken for Qingdi or someone intimate to him.
title: 段狂反扑，拓拔野喝止

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC16 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC16 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH03 and SH04 required storyboard regeneration before pass.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 玄蛇将段聿铠缠住，庭院内外都因拓拔野的惊呼而注意到院中有人。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 段聿铠在盛怒之下震开玄蛇，以万壑春藤绕反制，短暂翻转战局，逼得十四郎狼狈后退。黑衣老者奏琴加入压制，朝阳谷众人一拥而上。段聿铠终因伤重再度倒下，长刀齐落。拓拔野再也按捺不住，大喝住手，院外众人误以为青帝发怒，不敢妄动。拓拔野灵机一动，顺势借势救人，为下一段“假借青帝之名周旋”做铺垫。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后十四郎与科沙度开始试探拓拔野身份，拓拔野顺势扮作青帝身边人并要求将段聿铠抬到门前。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant, restrained, and mostly hidden; she should not suddenly take over the action beat.
Duan Yukai remains bloodied, defiant, and increasingly desperate; no invented weapons beyond the described combat and magic.
Chaoyang Valley forces remain black-clothed and somewhat faceless pressure; do not over-individualize the crowd.
The black serpent remains dark, magical, and non-gory. If green spring-vine magic appears, it should read as wooden vine overgrowth, not body horror.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the escalation readable: reversal, swarm pressure, collapse, and the shouted interruption should each get their own clear beat rather than turning into one dense melee image.
